title: Multiply the series
text: The coefficient of $$x^n$$ in the product is the sum of $$2k$$ for $$k=0$$ up to $$k=n$$, since each term of f has coefficient $$2$$ and the term $$k x^k$$ of g pairs with $$2x^{n-k}$$.

title: Add them up
text: The sum of the integers from $$0$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n \left(n+1\right)}{2}$$, so the coefficient is $$\frac{2n \left(n+1\right)}{2}=n \left(n+1\right)$$.
